base_rule: For each non-root artifact, consider candidates preceding it in (canonical size, SHA) order. Choose the greatest equal-prefix plus nonoverlapping equal-suffix total; break ties by base SHA. Keep the single delta only if its complete file, including its 89-byte header, is smaller than the saved adaptive full encoding.
production_choice: Minimum actual complete-store bytes of certified delta and saved certified flat optimum; retain the flat format on ties. Include mandatory roots and all metadata. No regression in available storage bytes by construction, not a claim of strict improvement.
solid_archive_control: Apply the previous adaptive raw/zlib9/XZ6/gzip9 and reversible byte shuffle to a canonical length-indexed concatenation of the original flat-optimum canonical files. Evaluate metadata inside and outside the packed stream and keep the smaller actual standalone container. This byte-only control has no per-file random-access claim.
unavailable_rule: Keep both Letter conditions. Do not infer a new optimum from its selected-only payload set or fill missing payloads with a surrogate. Count unavailable and uncertified conditions as nonwins in the full denominator.
qualification: Fixed-catalogue byte-level follow-up using original saved canonical payloads. Decode and hash every selected payload and verify every allowed fault-set certificate. No new timing measurements or full model-replay census is claimed. Report all controls, ties, losses, timeouts and missing data. Equal-format independently coded exact optimization remains an oracle control that can tie; absolute supremacy is not a possible success criterion. The eight scientific histories informed exploratory pilots and are not held-out validation.
